F13 an item note is optional, counted and capped at 120 characters
F14 adding shows a confirmation and the cart bar with count and total
F15 booking-only items offer a call instead of add
F16 cart: quantity, total, delete and the empty state
F17 the cart survives a reload and stays separate per branch
F18 closed branch: cart explains and blocks checkout
F19 Escape closes the item window and focus returns to the item
F20 the phone Back button closes an open item window instead of leaving the menu

specs.title: F21 empty cart: the page says so and leads back to the menu
F22 missing fields: one clear message each and focus on the first
F23 phone: Arabic digits accepted, wrong prefix refused
F24 zone fee and the 14% Tagamoa tax appear before confirming
F25 pickup hides the address and shows the branch address
F26 what was typed survives a reload and the trip back to the menu
F27 an unknown zone has a way out: the branch phone
F28 a closed branch cannot confirm, and says when to come back
F29 confirming shows the order number, empties the cart and remembers the order
F30 a fourth order from one phone within 10 minutes is refused with a clear message
F31 double tap on confirm places one order
F32 copy and WhatsApp share of the order number
F33 a status change on the staff board reaches the open order page without reload
F34 «اطلب مرة أخرى» returns to the same branch menu
F35 an order link without the phone asks for it; a wrong phone finds nothing
F36 tracking: clear errors, then the right number and phone open the order
F37 an unknown address shows the not-found page with branch links
F38 filters by status, branch and search narrow the board
F39 a new order moves through its statuses on the board
F40 cancelling needs a reason, «سبب آخر» needs words
F41 details show items with notes, and the POS invoice number is saved
F42 a new order placed in another tab appears on the open board
F43 zones: refuse empty and duplicate, accept Arabic digits, reach checkout, delete with confirmation
F44 a pending zone can be priced from its button
F45 the staff board has no sign-in (demo): anyone with the link can see customer data
